article.hook: Someone in your world just stopped sharing - without telling you why. That’s Lilith in Scorpio locking down the emotional vault for nine months. Secrets don’t leak; they explode when poked hard enough.
article.lived: For nearly a year, people around you will carry a low hum of tension beneath calm surfaces. A glance or a silence says more than words. You’ll notice how vulnerability triggers a shutdown reflex - trust is a currency spent with extreme caution. The air tightens in meetings, texts come back clipped, and the usual small talk feels like a trap you want to avoid.
article.turn: Intensity turns toxic when suspicion sharpens into accusation. The same instinct that scans for danger can turn you into a closed circuit, lashing out at anyone who presses too close. Protecting wounds by burning bridges leaves nothing left to heal.
moves: Name one thing you refuse to explain and why it matters.
